title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A security vulnerability exists in Keycloak versions prior to 26.7.5-r3 involving the MariaDB Connector/J used for Java applications connecting to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability has a medium severity with an impact on integrity but no impact on confidentiality or availability. A fix is available in version 26.7.5-r3.
